summary: User sent approximately $7422 worth of WETH over the Base network to a Coinbase deposit address that did not support the transfer as intended. The tokens remained at an address controlled by Coinbase and the user reported being unable to recover them through Coinbase.
prevention: Verify the receiving platform supports the asset and network before transferring / Send a small test transaction before transferring a significant amount
classification_warning: funds reportedly remain on-chain at an address controlled by Coinbase
